Base Threat: Sensitive data is compromised though attacks against SSL/TLS

Base Threat: Sensitive data is compromised though attacks against SSL/TLS
Model Threat: The Java Web Service returns a detailed stack trace in an error message to the client. Base Threat: Sensitive data is compromised though attacks against SSL/TLS
Model Threat: A user's session ID is passed in the URL. Base Threat: Attackers obtain unauthorised access by connecting directly to the service
